Verify Now Blog > PCBWay to Exhibit at SIDO Lyon 2026: Meet Us at Booth E122 PCBWay to Exhibit at SIDO Lyon 2026: Meet Us at Booth E122 by: Mila Sep 07,2026 <dynamic-value> <dynamic-value> Posted in News As smart technologies continue to transform industrial products and connected devices, reliable hardware manufacturing has become an essential part of turning innovative concepts into real-world products. From September 16 to 17, 2026, SIDO Lyon 2026 will bring together technology providers, industrial companies, startups, and innovation professionals at the Lyon Convention Centre in France. The event focuses on the convergence of IoT, Artificial Intelligence, Robotics, and Extended Reality (XR), with a strong emphasis on practical industrial applications and digital transformation. PCBWay will be exhibiting at Booth E122. We warmly invite you to visit us and explore how our manufacturing services can support your next hardware project. PCBWay at SIDO Lyon 2026 Event: SIDO Lyon 2026 Date: September 16–17, 2026 Venue: Lyon Convention Centre, Cité Internationale, Lyon, France Booth: E122 SIDO Lyon is designed to connect technology solutions with companies working on real-world digitalization and Industry 4.0 projects. The 2026 edition is expected to bring together more than 300 exhibitors, with technologies covering IoT, AI, robotics, digital twins, XR, cybersecurity, and prototyping. For hardware developers, these technologies ultimately depend on one critical foundation: reliable physical products that can move efficiently from concept to production. From Prototype to Production Developing an IoT device, robotic system, industrial controller, or smart product often involves more than designing a PCB. Hardware teams may need to coordinate electronics, mechanical components, enclosures, prototypes, and final assembly throughout the development process. PCBWay provides a range of manufacturing services to support these requirements, including: PCB Manufacturing PCB Assembly (PCBA) HDI and Flex PCB Rigid-Flex PCB CNC Machining 3D Printing Injection Molding Sheet Metal Fabrication Box Build Assembly This integrated approach helps hardware teams reduce the complexity of working with multiple manufacturing suppliers and makes it easier to move from an initial prototype toward small-batch and production manufacturing. Meet PCBWay at Booth E122 If you are attending SIDO Lyon 2026, come and visit PCBWay at Booth E122. The exhibition will be an opportunity to discuss your current or upcoming hardware projects, explore manufacturing solutions, and learn more about how PCBWay can support projects ranging from early-stage prototypes to production. Whether you are developing an IoT device, robotic system, industrial controller, smart sensor, embedded product, or other electronic hardware, our team will be happy to discuss your manufacturing requirements. Visit us at Booth E122 and let's bring your next hardware idea to life.
